title: Sleepwalker Dub
description: A slow, hazy downtempo cut built around a rolling sub-bass and a broken 808 kick, with sparse claps and ducking hats drifting in and out. A dub-tinged pad opens and closes like fog while perlin-driven motion keeps everything slowly breathing, ending on a long delayed tail.
code:
setcpm(92/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(180,360).slow(12)).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.05),
    s("hh(3,8,1)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).hpf(6000).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").add(note("<0 0 0 -2>")).s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(200,420).slow(10)).gain(0.6),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("supersaw").lpf(perlin.range(300,1400).slow(16)).room(0).delay(".4:.375:.6").gain(0.5)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.7).delay(".3:.25:.5").sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(1.5)),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).hpf(7000).cut(1).degradeBy(0.25),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1 eb1 f1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(220,520).slow(9)).gain(0.6).shape(0.2),
    n("0 ~ <3 5> ~").scale("C3:phrygian").s("casio").vowel("<a o e>").gain(0.45).delay(".5:.375:.6").off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(180,400).slow(14)).gain(0.6),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("supersaw").lpf(perlin.range(400,2600).slow(8)).delay(".5:.5:.7").gain(0.5).crush(8)
  )],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.7).delay(".3:.25:.5"),
    s("hh(7,8,3)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).hpf(7000).cut(1).degradeBy(0.3),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1 eb1 f1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(240,640).slow(7)).gain(0.6).shape(0.25),
    n("0 ~ <3 5> <2 ~>").scale("C3:phrygian").s("casio").vowel("<a o e>").gain(0.45).delay(".5:.375:.6").sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.add(note(12))).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.3))
  )],
  [14, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(160,340).slow(14)).gain(0.55).delay(".5:.5:.7"),
    s("hh(3,8,1)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.35).hpf(8000).cut(1).degradeBy(0.4).delay(".4:.375:.6")
  )]
)
